cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can finally use what I taught you about parties. Help me surprise Denise on Friday; you choose the decorations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time you let me choose, then replaced everything with silver balloons.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You were still learning restraint. This time I'll wash glasses and leave your choices alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Even if I use the enormous paper sun you made me take down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put it up. If Denise notices it before Friday, tell her you're revisiting an early influence. Just don't say I'm helping.

reason: Make B distrust the claimed freedom, then require A to tolerate a rejected design as the price of recruiting a secret collaborator.
